body:
THE THREE FACES OF THEODORE KACZYNSKI

Ross quoted from the Manifesto:
>HUMAN SUFFERING 
>167.  If the breakdown is sudden, many people
>will die, .... Even if the breakdown
>is gradual ...              ... the process
>of de-industrialization probably will be very chaotic
>and involve much suffering.  

This and the rest of the Manifesto constitutes the face TK wants
to show to the world -- that of a caring surgeon who must
reluctantly cause pain and suffering while amputating a limb, all
for the greater good of saving the patient's life.

TK's admission to the 1979 airplane bombing in notes found in his
cabin unmasks the private face which TK reveals only to himself.
[Copies of this and other admissions can be found at The Truth is
Redacted web site.]

  "Dec. 29, 1979: In some of my notes I mention a plan
   for revenge on society. Plan was to blow up an airliner
   in flight. Late summer and early autumn I constructed
   device. Much expense because had to go to Gr. Falls
   (Great Falls, Mont.) to buy material, including barometer
   and many boxes cartridges for the powder. I put more than
   a quart of smokeless powder in a can, rigged barometer so
   device would explode at 2000 ft. or conceivably as high
   as 3500 ft."
        
So plain old "revenge" and a desire to get even for some imagined 
wrong was TK's real reason for attempting to murder everyone on
board the American Airlines 727.  Here pain and suffering is
revealed as the whole purpose of the enterprise -- not some
unavoidable side effect.  But this is looking at things from the
point of view of TK's potential victims, which by the way
includes just about everyone alive at the time.  

What did taking "revenge on society" mean for TK himself?  We can
only speculate but he probably saw himself as avenging wrongs and
injustices so he would be able to view his own actions as
moralistic and noble.  And then there are the feelings of power
and self-importance he probably got from the taking on the whole
world and through his bombs being able to strike at whomever he
choses.  To use the slang of the 60's -- it would have a great
ego-trip for him.

What about TK's third face, the true face of Theodore Kaczynski?
Figuring that out is what makes this an interesting case.  Rather
than spoil anyone's fun, I'll leave that as a puzzle for the
reader.
